name: Euric
role: King of the Visigoths from 466 to 484
image_credit: Manuel Rodríguez de Guzmán · Public domain

checks.lead: Euric, also known as Evaric (c. 426 – 28 December 484), son of Theodoric I, ruled as king (rex) of the Visigoths, after murdering his brother, Theodoric II, from 466 until his death in 484. Sometimes he is called Euric II.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
